description: This file defines a PascalVocGenerator class for generating dataset annotations for Pascal VOC datasets, including methods for loading images, parsing XML annotations, and mapping class labels.

classes.name: PascalVocGenerator
classes.description: A data generator class for Pascal VOC dataset, inheriting from Generator, providing methods for dataset size, class labels, image loading, and annotation parsing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PascalVocGenerator with dataset directory, set name, classes, image extension, and options to skip truncated or difficult objects.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of images in the dataset.

methods.name: num_classes
methods.description: Returns the number of classes in the dataset.

methods.name: has_label
methods.description: Checks if a label is known in the dataset.

methods.name: has_name
methods.description: Checks if a class name is known.

methods.name: name_to_label
methods.description: Converts a class name to its label index.

methods.name: label_to_name
methods.description: Converts a label index to its class name.

methods.name: image_aspect_ratio
methods.description: Calculates the aspect ratio of an image given its index.

methods.name: image_path
methods.description: Returns the file path of an image given its index.

methods.name: load_image
methods.description: Loads an image as a BGR array given its index.

methods.name: __parse_annotation
methods.description: Parses an XML element representing an object annotation, returning truncated, difficult flags, bounding box, and label.

methods.name: __parse_annotations
methods.description: Parses all object annotations from an XML root element.

methods.name: load_annotations
methods.description: Loads and parses annotations for a given image index.
